name: qa-company-formation
description: Qatar mainland company formation and entity choice for 2026, focused on limited liability companies under Commercial Companies Law 11/2015 and foreign investment approval under Law 1/2019. Use for Qatar LLC or WLL formation, shareholder liability, number of partners, capital, constitutional documents, foreign ownership above 49%, incorporation approvals and the distinction between commercial registration and tax registration. Separates mainland approval from Qatar Financial Centre and free-zone regimes and routes the new company's corporate income tax, related-party, nonresident withholding and payroll obligations to the current Qatar tax Guides. Excludes unverified fee quotes, service turnaround promises and transaction-specific sector licensing advice.
